column4: Notes from the pricing review. We agreed to hold list prices flat until March.
Except for the premium support tier, which goes up by five percent in January.
Right. Existing customers keep their current rate until their renewal date.
Action items. I will update the price sheet and the renewal template.
And I will email the account managers with a short summary and the new dates.
Let's also flag the three renewals due in December, since those are affected first.
I will list them in the email, with the renewal owner for each one.
Good. And we should check whether any of them were promised a price lock.
I will check the contracts this afternoon. Anything else?
One more point. Sales wants the new prices in the system by the fifteenth of December.
Then I will finish the price sheet by the tenth, which leaves time for a check.
